Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to start vendor master setup on our side so we can raise the first PO and route invoices to AP. To keep things moving, could you please: 

- Complete the attached Redwood vendor profile template (legal entity name, mailing and remit addresses, primary billing contact, authorized signatory).
- Attach a current W-9 (or equivalent tax form if different) and the certificate of incorporation/registration.
- Confirm the preferred payment method (ACH is preferred) and provide either a bank letter or a voided check for ACH validation.
- Let us know your standard payment terms (Net 30, Net 45, etc.) and who should receive POs.

I've attached a blank vendor profile template to this thread for your convenience. Once we have all the docs, I'll route to AP for verification and vendor code creation.

Target timelines: if you can return everything by EOD Wednesday (3/3), we aim to have a vendor ID and first PO ready the week of 3/7.

Thanks — and let me know if any of the items above are sensitive and need to be sent to a secure upload link.

Best,
Olga

Thanks for the ping, Olga. I reviewed the attached W-9 and certificate. A few items and next steps from AP: 

- W-9 EIN (12-3456789) looks consistent with the legal name on the incorporation certificate. We'll run the EIN match against our vendor validation service and confirm.
- For ACH setup we require a bank letter or voided check. DocuSign is acceptable if the document is clearly bank-issued and includes account/micro routing info. Do not send account details over unencrypted email.
- Once validation is complete we'll issue vendor code VND-45217 and enable Net 30 payment terms by default (we can change if vendor requests different terms in contract).
- Expected turnaround: 2 business days after we receive the bank letter and finish EIN validation.

Please send Elena the secure upload link for the bank letter and copy AP (finance@redwood.com) on the upload confirmation.

-Karthik
